sloka: पतिसंयोगसुलभं वयो दृष्ट्वा तु मे पिता ।चिन्तामभ्यगमद्दीनो वित्तनाशादिवाधन: ॥ २.११८.३४॥
transliteration: patisaṁyogasulabhaṁ vayo dṛṣṭvā tu me pitā ।cintāmabhyagamaddīno vittanāśādivādhana: ॥ 2.118.34॥

translations.english: When my father saw I had attained the marriageable age, he was immersed in sorrow like an indigent man who had lost all his wealth.
